explain: Model-selected actions still pass a deterministic authority check. An instruction in a document cannot extend the dispatcher's capability set.
steps: Accept a proposed tool name as untrusted input. || Reject tools outside the run's permitted scope before executing them.
name: tool-authority

explain: Remote exposure needs independently configured authentication, origin handling, transport protection, and quotas. Local defaults alone do not establish readiness.
steps: Record the required controls as explicit deployment checks. || Fail readiness when any required boundary is missing.
name: remote-controls

explain: A citation resolves to an exact retained revision and rechecks the viewer's access. Having a valid label does not authorize opening it.
steps: Resolve a server-owned label mapping. || Return the bounded span only to the authoritative owner.
name: citation-authorization

explain: Untrusted file processing needs resource limits and restricted execution. This is a declarative isolation policy, not a sandbox implemented by Python dictionaries.
steps: State parser byte, time, and outbound-network limits. || Reject a deployment configuration with unrestricted egress.
name: parser-isolation

explain: A knowledge facade composes authorization, search, and bounded source lookup. Read and management operations are separate opt-ins rather than implied by one connection.
steps: Register only read capabilities for this run. || Verify that a management capability remains unavailable.
name: service-facade
